prompts.elite:
Gently simplify Image 1, the existing original RED flight-game encounter warning banner for 少女航线. This is a small definite refinement, not a new layout: keep the crisp white centered text, clear center emblem raised above the shoulders, the same straight side-to-side full-bleed crimson glass strip, upward central bracket silhouette and title placement, and realistic glow baked into game art. Match its height and dimensions. Both rails and the red backing must meet the left and right image boundaries, flush with no vertical end-caps or horizontal inset. Remove the extra secondary reticle at far left if present, ornate thin stepped outline traces on both ends, small diagonal calibration ticks, clutter under the headline, and most small specular hotspots. Use smoother large dark burgundy surfaces, delicate steel top facets on the central brackets, two crisp warmly lit edge rails, and one thin tapered inset line on each side of the headline. Keep a little depth and the sporty emergency atmosphere, with cleaner outer thirds and the same dramatic span. The entire sprite is about 3.6:1 in width to visible height. Above and below the banner, and around the raised emblem, use genuine transparent pixels, no solid background, no screenshot, no checkerboard pattern, no other words or graphics. Preserve readability at phone size.

Keep the original central triangle with bright exclamation mark and the refined round red optical reticle. Simplify a small amount only. Keep the warmth distinction of the original strong-enemy warning. The title must be precisely 强敌来袭, characters 强 敌 来 袭, no punctuation or extra title.
